title: Fix Python EDHOC OSCORE role mapping (RFC 9528 Table 14)
description: python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py exports OSCORE sender_id = C_I; RFC 9528 Appendix A.1 Table 14 requires initiator Sender ID = C_R. Rust implementation is correct. This makes the pre-existing rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs test_edhoc_exported_context_matches_vectors fail under --features edhoc, and the incorrect mapping is baked into test/vectors/edhoc.json. Fix: Python initiator export uses C_R as sender_id / C_I as recipient_id, regenerate edhoc.json, correct the vectors.rs expectation stays as-is (it asserts RFC-correct), update python tests. Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.6.8.9 cross-validation work 2026-08-28.
